description: Manage YOUR OWN personal work schedule. action is one of: create, update, delete, assign (assign = make a schedule your active one). For update/delete/assign, provide schedule_id. default_hours is your standard daily hours (for a simple schedule). The organization is fixed by your context, and you can only manage your own schedule.

action.description: What to do (required): create, update, delete, or assign.

default_hours.description: Standard daily working hours for a simple schedule (e.g. 8).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

schedule_id.description: Id of your schedule (required for update, delete, assign).

name: manage_user_work_schedule
